description: Pins a note to a day on a board's charts, e.g. "Launched pricing v2": for one site (scope "site", the default when site is given) or every site on the board (scope "board"). Needs a key with write access ("Allow notes and exports"). Text is kept to 80 characters.

board.description: The board the note goes on: its id from list_boards, or its exact name

scope.description: site: only this site's charts; board: every site on the board. Default: site when site is given, else board

site.description: The site the note is about (needed for scope site)

text.description: What happened, e.g. Launched pricing v2

name: add_annotation
title: Add a note
